question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Hamper
solution:
The correct answer is: **Hinder**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Hamper"** means to obstruct or make the progress of something slower or more difficult. (बाधा डालना)

 
 
• **Example:** The heavy rain hampered our plans for the outdoor event.
 
 
 
• **"Hinder"** refers to causing delay or interruption in the progress of something. (अड़चन डालना)
 
 
• **Example:** The lack of funds hindered the completion of the project.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym for **'Hamper' **is **'Hinder'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Hinder**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Gift** (उपहार): Something that is given voluntarily without payment, as a token of appreciation or love.

 
 
• **Example:** She received a beautiful gift on her birthday.
 
 
 
• **Irritate** (चिढ़ाना): To annoy or provoke someone to impatience or anger.
 
 
• **Example:** His constant interruptions irritated everyone in the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Pamper** (लाड़-प्यार करना): To indulge someone excessively, often by giving them unnecessary comfort or luxury.
 
 
• **Example:** She loves to pamper her pets with special treats.
 
 

41:Ta6b,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
